input: single-cell RNAseq data (data set 9) in the publication scFASTCORMICS: A contextualization algorithm to reconstruct metabolic multi-cell population models from single-cell RNAseq data
raw_text:
The present dataset (dataset9) was used as input to build scFASTCORMICS models. The files correspond to the clusters identified by Seurat in the single-cell data from pancreas donor7 downloaded from the GEO website  (GSE114297). 

 

see the protocol: scFASTCORMICS: A contextualization algorithm to reconstruct metabolic multi-cell population models from single-cell RNAseq data

and github: https://github.com/sysbiolux/scFASTCORMICS

For more information, version updates of the scFASTCORMICS.
